data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 4444 reported a favourable movement in prior period reserves totalling approximately GBP 50.1m (net) in 2022, driven primarily by better-than-expected claims emergence across most classes and, in particular, reductions in reserves previously held for COVID-19 exposures. This prior-year improvement (a release) partly offset major 2022 catastrophe losses such as Hurricane Ian and the Ukraine war. The opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2022 was GBP 1,980.61m (gross).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) gross amount was not present as a single gross 'movement in prior years' line in the notes that was unambiguously labelled 'Insurance liabilities'. The report explicitly states a prior period favourable development of GBP 50.1m (narrative) and Note 9 provides a net favourable run-off of GBP 50,092k; these figures are net of reinsurance. This extraction therefore used the net prior period release (explicitly stated) as a fallback since a single gross PYD figure could not be located in the available text/images. A gross claims development triangle is present in the technical reserves notes (page ~26) but its detailed cells were not fully extracted here; that triangle could be used to compute a gross PYD if required. Some LOB mappings for the run-off table were inferred (e.g. 'Pecuniary Loss''Professional Lines', 'Marine, aviation and transport''Marine'/'Aviation'), and where the run-off table used parentheses to indicate adverse movements the sign convention was converted to the required release/strengthening convention. RITC/LPT activity (notably the 2021 LPT) may distort development comparisons; this may affect gross PYD calculation from the triangle.
